purpose: Extensive post-closeout scan for residual routes into the retired pre-OPS3 governance/control system, followed by an owner-interface and external-practice cross-check.
scope: live ChatGPT Project Source text files and sanitized ZIP references
connected Airtable technical-control markers and authority framing
method: ChatGPT Project Source exact in-file search
byte/member scan of sanitized DB-004 and 8E provenance ZIPs
connected Drive and Airtable retired-marker search
external research comparison against OpenAI and Anthropic engineering guidance

red_findings: legacy .ai decision ledger lacked OPS3 non-authority classification
legacy workspace/MS-02/IA/Stage-A/WP verifiers read application-side retired authority paths
A2 preflight/task-capsule modules and doctor still consumed retired work-order state
Development Bible AI-development and roadmap volumes still presented semantic authority/current authorization
workflow trigger coverage did not include every audited documentation/control namespace
application.disposition: legacy executable surfaces fail closed; old AI-development/roadmap volumes are historical inert; approved-decisions is background-only; CI watches the full audited namespace

red_findings: closed PPiA/CAPP/Stage-A/IA validators still read retired pointer/status/index surfaces
legacy interaction-system index/pilot/scorecard still looked live
DWC lane recovery still referenced the global V2 termination/pointer system
application dependency roadmap still carried V2 semantic runtime-authority language
sibling validators from closed program families remained executable even when they did not contain an exact retired pointer
aioc.disposition: closed-program validator families fail closed and route to OPS3; interaction system is historical inert; DWC recovery is lane-scoped under OPS3; application roadmap is background-only; CI watches scripts/tools and audited lane/reference surfaces; owner prompt patterns remain inside an explicitly non-authoritative adapter guarded by semantic CI

google_drive.semantic_search_note: generic phrases such as runtime authority or exact next operation produced business/legal/support material, not a technical Multiversal selector

airtable.authority_framing: business/support evidence; not software current-state authority

findings: prefer outcome-first task prompts and reserve absolute rules for real invariants rather than carrying forward legacy prompt stacks
prefer one flexible base prompt/template with small variables or modifiers over many independently maintained prompts
keep context high-signal and retrieve only what the current task needs rather than preloading unrelated history
use simple composable agent/workflow patterns and add complexity only when measured results justify it
use environmental evidence, programmatic checks and evals to detect failure instead of relying on prompt wording alone
external_research_crosscheck.ops3_implication: Owner prompts should express objective, relevant boundaries and observed symptoms. Canonical behavior/state belongs in OPS3 and machine-enforced validators, not repeated ritual prompt text.

owner_interface.design: one bootstrap pattern plus composable objective/modifier snippets; no prompt snippet may select current work, redefine Continue, grant authority or override canonical state/contract

historical_evidence_rule: Old system names may remain in immutable receipts, evidence, work-state history and Git history. Such evidence is not live routing or authority.
